faqs.q: Is AlgoTrader 9 safe, legit or a scam?
faqs.a: We found no scam indicators in the product, which reads as a functioning AI trading service. The conditions are editorial: claims without verification, conflicting figures and restriction lists that disagree. We rate it safe to research with the conditions in this review.

faqs.q: Is it really fee-free?
faqs.a: The platform fee is absent, but every trade carries a broker spread the page itself calls the real cost. The headline says free; the fine print says otherwise. Budget for the fine print.

faqs.a: 10 crypto assets through broker partners, per the published pages. The list varies between sections, so check the dashboard after signup.

faqs.q: What happens after I sign up?
faqs.a: You confirm the account by email, fund US$250, set your risk preferences and choose automatic or manual mode. The demo account runs alongside while you learn.

bottomLine: The desk, the demo and the funding options all check out. The score reflects the paperwork around them.
